```text
# #4259: Patch: follow-up to #4258 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

<!-- jackioh-bot:spot-check-follow-up #4258 -->
The after-merge spot-check of #4258 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44463478889)) found 2 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`1955aebdce40`). `claude-1` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #4258 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `spec/rulings/R3540005.md`: The spec still says the client draws the hero's Burn and Toxic on the hero's portrait, but this change moved them off the portrait into the tray, so the spec and the code now disagree and the spec was not updated in the same PR.
  Evidence: R3540005.md: "The client draws each as its own badge … and on the hero's portrait (`.hero-burn`, `.hero-toxic`, shown above 0)". The folded paragraph at spec/11-rulings.md:1738 says the same ("on the hero's portrait"). The diff removes those spans from Hero.tsx and draws them in HeroTray.tsx's `hero-counters-<side>`. CLAUDE.md asks that the spec change in the same PR. The fix is to amend R3540005's note to say they are drawn as labelled chips in the hero's tray, outside its overflow allowance, following spec/README's process for amending a note. R987 ('by the hero's portrait') and R3548000 ('beside the player's hero') still read true.
- [ ] `apps/web/src/game/board.css:194`: Above 600px the new tray chips still pick up the old portrait-pill rule, so they are 28px tall beside modifier chips of about 19.5px. That makes the tray taller toward the field, and no spec checks a tray that carries counters against the zones and hands, which is the phone-plate risk the issue said the component spec would cover.
  Evidence: The group rule `.hero-health, .hero-armor, .hero-jade, .hero-burn, .hero-toxic, .hero-tipsy, .hero-credits, .hero-luck { min-width: 28px; height: 28px; font-weight: 800; box-shadow … }` (board.css:194-215) still matches the chips. Nothing overrides that height except the ≤600px `.hero-tray .modifier-badge { height: var(--tray-chip-h) }` (board.css:3743). `.modifier-badge` itself (board.css:343) sets no height: about 10px × 1.35 line-height + 2×2px padding + 2px border ≈ 19.5px. The only check that a tray covers no zone or hand is board-layout.cy.tsx:318, and its view (8 modifiers, 2 secrets, Rift, 3 Jade) has no Luck, Burn, Toxic or Tipsy. The new emotes-layout spec only checks the eight counters against each other. The fix is to size `.hero-tray .hero-counter` like a tray chip and give the board-layout tray-overlap view every tray counter above 0.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44464515421)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal
Fix the two spot-check findings from #4258 without reverting it. Amend ruling note `R3540005` so the spec agrees the hero's Burn and Toxic now ride the hero's tray as labelled chips, and shrink the tray's `.hero-counter` chips from the 28px portrait-pill rule to tray-chip size while extending the board-layout tray-overlap view to carry every tray counter above 0. `R987` and `R3548000` stay as written.
## Files to touch
| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `spec/rulings/R3540005.md` | change | One sentence: portrait badges become tray chips (wording in step 2) |
| `spec/pending/4259.md` | new | The §11 paragraph recording the amendment |
| `apps/web/src/game/board.css` | change | Narrow the pill group rule; extend `.hero-tray .hero-counter` with tray-chip sizing |
| `e2e/cypress/component/board-layout.cy.tsx` | change | `heavyView()` gains Luck/Burn/Toxic/Tipsy; allowance selectors exclude `.hero-counter` |
| `apps/web/src/game/hero-counters.test.tsx` | change | One CSS-content assertion that the chip rule sizes like a tray chip |
Do not touch `crates/`, `apps/edge/`, `apps/admin/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `Hero.tsx`, `HeroTray.tsx`, `emotes.css`, or the folded `spec/11-rulings.md` / `spec/INDEX.md` / `spec/CARDS.md`. Governing spec: `spec/README.md` (Adding a ruling), rulings `R3540005`, `R987`, `R3548000`, `R3540000`.
## Steps
1. Re-read `spec/README.md` (Adding a ruling), `spec/rulings/R3540005.md`, `spec/rulings/R0987.md`, `spec/rulings/R3548000.md`, `apps/web/src/game/board.css` lines 194–250 and 426–446, `apps/web/src/game/HeroTray.tsx` `CounterChip`, and `e2e/cypress/component/board-layout.cy.tsx` lines 195–350.
2. In `spec/rulings/R3540005.md`, replace `and on the hero's portrait (`.hero-burn`, `.hero-toxic`, shown above 0), titled "Burn counters" and "Toxic counters"` with `and as labelled chips in the hero's tray (`.hero-burn`, `.hero-toxic` inside `hero-counters-<side>`, shown above 0 with their names beside their counts), outside the tray's overflow allowance, titled "Burn counters" and "Toxic counters"`. Leave the Unit badges, the `counterChanged`/`hero-<player>` sentence, the battle-log sentence, and the Rejected line untouched. Verify `R0987.md` ("Luck badge by the hero's portrait") and `R3548000` ("stein beside the player's hero") still describe the tray, and do not edit them.
3. Create `spec/pending/4259.md` with one line: `**[[R3540005]] The hero's Burn and Toxic ride the tray (issue #4259, <date>):** amends [[R3540005]] under no new number: the hero's Burn and Toxic are no longer drawn on the hero's portrait; they ride the hero's tray as labelled chips beside the modifiers, outside the overflow allowance, as [[R987]]'s Luck and [[R3548000]]'s Tipsy do. It amends [[R3540005]] and edits nothing in the sections.` Use `date +%F` for `<date>`.
4. In `board.css`, narrow the group rule at lines 194–201 to `.hero-health, .hero-armor, .hero-jade, .hero-credits` (drop `.hero-burn, .hero-toxic, .hero-tipsy, .hero-luck`; nothing on the portrait uses them since #4251 — portrait holds only Jade and Credits plus health/armor from `emotes.css`). Then extend the existing `.hero-tray .hero-counter` rule (line 435) to reset every pill property the group rule used to supply, keeping the `inline-flex`/gap/color lines:
`.hero-tray .hero-counter { flex: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-2); min-width: 0; height: auto; font-weight: inherit; text-shadow: none; box-shadow: none; color: var(--pal-white); }`
Padding, font-size, and line-height already come from its `modifier-badge` class (defined later at line 343, equal specificity), and the ≤600px `height: var(--tray-chip-h)` rule (line 3743, later in the file) still wins on phones. Do not touch `.hero-counter.hero-burn/.hero-toxic/.hero-tipsy` color rules or the Luck rule in `emotes.css`.
5. In `board-layout.cy.tsx` `heavyView()`: add `luck: 2` and `tipsy: 4` to both seats, `hero: { ...burn: 6, toxic: 2 }` on your seat, and extend the opponent's hero object with `burn: 6, toxic: 2` (it currently overrides the hero without them). In the `#2877 each tray shows the layout's allowance` test, change both `[data-testid="tray-<side>"] .modifier-badge` count selectors to `[data-testid="tray-<side>"] .modifier-badge:not(.hero-counter)`, since counter chips carry `modifier-badge` but sit outside the `+N` allowance (`HeroTray.tsx`: `data-count` counts entries only, so the `hidden` math is unchanged). Leave the no-overlap test's logic alone — it now covers counters automatically.
6. In `hero-counters.test.tsx`, in the `#4251 a counter rising from 0 moves no plate` test, add: `expect(boardCss).toMatch(/\.hero-tray \.hero-counter\s*\{[^}]*height:\s*auto;/)` and an assertion that the pill group rule no longer names the moved classes, e.g. `expect(boardCss).not.toMatch(/\.hero-burn,\s*\n\.hero-toxic,/)`.
7. Run: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/hero-counters.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/Hero.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/tipsy.test.tsx`. If Cypress component runs in this environment, run the board-layout spec (`pnpm --dir e2e test:component --spec cypress/component/board-layout.cy.tsx`); otherwise leave it to CI and say so.
## Tests
- `apps/web/src/game/hero-counters.test.tsx` (`#4251 … outside the overflow list`, extended step-6 CSS assertions): counters render beside the `+N` list; chip rule sizes like a tray chip. Run with `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/hero-counters.test.tsx`.
- `apps/web/src/game/Hero.test.tsx` (`R987 …`, `R3540005 …`): Luck/Burn/Toxic chips in `hero-counters-<side>`, absent at 0. Run with `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/Hero.test.tsx`.
- `apps/web/src/game/tipsy.test.tsx` (`R3548000 …`): stein chip in tray, absent at 0. Run with `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/tipsy.test.tsx`.
- `e2e/cypress/component/board-layout.cy.tsx` (`#2877 each tray shows …`, `#2877 no tray overlaps …`): allowance counts exclude counters; tray with all four counters overlaps no zone or hand on all six viewports.
- `cargo jackioh spec check`: amended note, pending paragraph, and existing `R3540005` tests agree.
## Done when
- `R3540005.md` describes tray chips and `spec/pending/4259.md` records the amendment; `R987`/`R3548000` untouched and still true.
- Above 600px tray counters render at tray-chip height (~19.5px, not 28px); phone behavior unchanged.
- `heavyView()` carries Luck, Burn, Toxic, Tipsy above 0 on both seats and the overlap test passes.
- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, and the three web test files are green with no skipped, ignored, or weakened tests.
## Risks
- Widening: four labelled chips widen the tray; on the 390px phone the `:has(.hero-counters)` left-align rule should absorb it, but if the overlap test finds a zone hit, narrow chip content (not the allowance) — counters must never fold into `+N`.
- Specificity: `emotes.css` `.hero-tray .hero-counter.hero-luck` (0,3,0) still beats the extended rule (0,2,0), so Luck keeps its colors; the narrowed group rule must not be re-widened by later portrait edits.
- `spec check` fails if the pending paragraph's links, date, or filename deviate — copy the `**[[R<n>]] … (issue #n, date):**` shape of `spec/pending/4132.md` exactly.
## Open questions
None. No person-only step is needed.
<!-- /jackioh-bot:plan -->
```
